name: Can you replace insulated (dual-pane) glass in a sliding door?

mainEntity.name: Can you replace insulated (dual-pane) glass in a sliding door?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we regularly replace insulated (dual-pane) glass units in sliding doors. These units are designed for energy efficiency, providing better insulation than single-pane glass. If your dual-pane glass shows signs of fogging or condensation between the panes, it indicates a failed seal, and replacement of the entire insulated glass unit (IGU) is necessary to restore its thermal performance. We ensure proper sealing for optimal energy efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, we can replace insulated (dual-pane) glass units. Fogging between panes means the seal failed, and replacement restores energy efficiency.
